title: Context spacesuit (predicating-regime fiber; ω < κ < ω₁)
description: Regime: transfinite-predication-category. The spacesuit IS the agent's predication fiber. Per lab/.../discourse-domain-locus/library/technology/context-spacesuit/context-spacesuit.md: 'A context spacesuit is the predetermined package of system prompt, rules, skills, agent definitions, memory, and session state loaded into a language model's context window before it begins work. The suit determines what the agent can perceive, what tools it can use, what constraints it operates under, and what history it carries.' In the predication algebra: 'the context spacesuit IS the agent's fiber. Loading the suit is extension (⊙) — adding the agent's context to the bare world. Constraining perception is restriction (⇒) — the suit limits responses to those available within the loaded fiber.' Different suits over the same task produce different Umwelten — different perceivable worlds from the same underlying structure. Predication fibers live in the transfinite-predication-category; the suit's load-time closure may require ω-many composition steps as nested skills/rules saturate, but converges below ω₁.
